snippet.title: Hungry Horrors - Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Hungry Horrors launches in Early Access on 19 January 2026.

Hungry Horrors is a roguelite card-based adventure game with a twist. You do not fight mythical creatures with swords or spells. You feed them. You play as a spoiled princess travelling across the British Isles cooking real regional dishes and feeding them to legendary Horrors before they reach you.

The game features
• creatures from British and Irish folklore
• relaxing turn based gameplay that rewards planning
• authentic regional British food like Haggis, Cranachan, Colcannon, Stargazy Pie and more
• each Horror has a unique personality and fatality
• 90s cartoon style pixel art, all hand animated in Aseprite
• whimsical and eerie original soundtrack by Henry Taylor

If you love games about strange cryptids and creepy mythological creatures, you will find plenty of grim beings in Hungry Horrors. If you enjoy cosy planning, strategy and gradual deckbuilding, this also gives a calm and thoughtful playing experience as you choose dishes, ingredients, flavour buffs and cookware.

Try the free demo on Steam and explore the world of hungry legends, twisted folklore and dark humour. 

Play Demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048840/Hungry_Horrors/

#hungryhorrors #indiegame #horrorgaming #cardgame
